user.title: Energy
user.description:
Map the inverter's sensors. {prefill}

Victron: put the MPPTs under MPPT PV (DC) and a grid-tie PV inverter under AC – the power flow then shows them where they connect. Otherwise use Solar production for all PV, load = AC consumption L1/L2/L3, grid = grid L1/L2/L3. Sunsynk/Deye: PV, load, grid and battery from Solar Assistant or Solarman. Leave house load empty to calculate it.

extras.title: Extra loads and signs
extras.description: Optional: big loads to show around the house in the power flow (aircon, pool pump, freezer…). The app needs battery power positive while CHARGING and grid positive while IMPORTING.
